papers.markingGuideNote: The scheme awards attempt marks of 2 for a 5-mark step and 3 for a 10-mark step. Deduct 3 for a mathematical error, or 1 for a numerical slip or minor misreading. papers.boundaryReview: Q2(iii) magnitude and direction carry separate 5-mark placements, as do the horizontal and vertical equations in Q7(ii), so each is split. The paired force diagrams in Q4(b)(i) share one 10-mark placement and remain together. Q5(i) paired speeds share their final 10-mark placement; Q8(a) follows the scheme’s worked order: three 5-mark placements establish omega, then one 5-mark placement establishes r. This reverses the order of the two printed asks but preserves both and the actual tariff. Q9(a) has an unnumbered, separately priced 10-mark statement of Archimedes’ principle, as well as (i) and (ii). The paper’s g=10 instruction is retained on gravity-dependent cards. Review correction: Q6(b) has separately priced x and y coordinate outputs. The original card ID is retained for x and the shared area work; y has its own 5-mark card. The common preparation is scored once, preserving the question tariff.
